messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD#47391 — p99 latency SLO breached in prod-us-west. p99=2.42s (SLO=1.2s). Top affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Autoscaler status: no recent scale-up. Preliminary note: traffic spike from a single tenant. Grafana: <https://grafana.redwood/prod/p99?panelId=9>.

alex.k: ack — I'm taking ownership. Triage-ing dashboards now.

jamie_sre: I can see KV cache eviction spikes and sidecar queue depth rising on svc-infer-*-usw. Hotkey pattern from tenant=acme-inc, burst ~5k rps hitting /v1/generate. Likely small prompt reuse causing repeated KV misses.

maria_prod: adding runbook checklist: 1) identify tenant; 2) apply tenant-scoped rate-limit; 3) enable model fallback to quantized variant; 4) warm KV cache / prefetch popular prefixes; 5) monitor p99 for 5m.

patrick: agree with plan. If fallback helps, we can avoid scaling commit. Quick mitigation preference.

alex.k: I'm going to apply a temporary tenant throttle and enable fallback. Command I'll run (dry-run first):
```
redwood route update --route /v1/generate --fallback-model redwood/llama-13b-q8 --scope tenant:acme-inc --dry-run
```
Then remove dry-run.

devops-bot: route-update-job-992 created, queued on controller-3.

jamie_sre: watch: KV eviction rate drops after 20s of prefetch. Queue depth trending down on node-7.

patrick: applied rate-limit: `tenant.acme-inc: 500rps` and enabled fallback. Verified config via api: `/config/routes/v1/generate` shows fallback active for tenant=acme-inc.

alex.k: running cache preload script now to warm common prefixes for acme. Script: `scripts/prefetch_kv.sh --tenant acme-inc --top 200`

jamie_sre: preliminary metrics: p99 for /v1/generate fell to 1.08s within 45s of changes. /v1/chat still ~1.4s but trending down.

maria_prod: Customer-impact assessment: support volume uptick, but no user-facing 500s reported yet. CS alerted with note: "mitigations in progress, monitoring".

elena_oncall: I'll standby for comms. If this holds for 5m, close PD. If p99 rebounds, we'll escalate to infra for reserved capacity or autoscaler commit.

alex.k: documenting actions in PD#47391: applied tenant rate-limit + model-fallback + KV warmup. No restarts. Will hand off monitoring to elena in 30m.

patrick: :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD#47391 acknowledged by alex.k. Auto-escalation suppressed for 15m.

elena_oncall: taking over monitoring and handoff. Next checkpoint at +5m. Handoff notes copied to incident tracker. alex.k -> elena_oncall.

alex.k: thanks — will keep watch until next checkpoint, then sign out.

elena_oncall: noted. If p99 stable <1.2s at checkpoint, I'll close incident and post a short postmortem summary. If not, I'll trigger autoscaler plan and ping infra.
